title: Heapside Armoury Key
summary: Opens the heavy chest inside the prison armoury at Basilisk Gate Barracks.

fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Use: Opens the heavy chest behind the iron gate inside the prison armoury at Basilisk Gate Barracks. A DC 15 Sleight of Hand check also opens it. The chest contains health potions.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
